findings.passage: I am compelled to express my strong opposition to the proposed SAVE Act, which seeks to impose stringent voter identification requirements under the guise of election security.
findings.note: Official press release statement ahead of the House vote on the SAVE Act. He says he opposes the bill because of its voter identification requirements.

findings.passage: The claim that this legislation is necessary to combat noncitizen voting is not backed by any significant evidence. In fact, studies have shown that voter fraud, especially by noncitizens, is exceedingly rare.
findings.note: He disputes the argument that the bill is needed to stop non-citizen voting, and says non-citizen fraud is rare.

findings.passage: We should be making it easier, not harder, for Americans to vote. Our democracy is strongest when every eligible citizen has a fair and equal opportunity to make their voice heard. I stand in firm opposition to the SAVE Act and any similar legislation that seeks to impose unnecessary barriers to voting.
findings.note: Closing of the same statement. He says he opposes the SAVE Act and similar bills.
